system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: listed automatically in the agent's system prompts via the {{.UserFiles}} template variable, which renders a compact <task_files> XML block
system_prompt_style.note: Settings -> Prompts manages system/human/tool templates per agent role; templated with variables rendered per flow.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Built-in suite of 20+ professional security tools including nmap, metasploit, sqlmap, and more.
env_context_strategy.note: Also has Knowledge Graph and vector store retrieval reachable, which could make this mixed; coded conservatively as agent-driven navigation given primary tool-use description.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The chain summarization system manages conversation context growth by selectively summarizing older messages.
context_compaction.note: Configurable via SUMMARIZER_* env vars, default enabled.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Inspect tool activity and terminal output as the flow runs
observation_format.evidence_locator: README.md (Monitor execution and review output section)
observation_format.note: Web scraper may return rendered HTML content but no explicit screenshot/image content evidenced.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Tool Calling: Robust function calling with exceptional accuracy for security tool orchestration
tool_call_format.note: Stated for multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock) as function/tool calling.

tool_count.note: README states '20+ professional security tools' and 'Comprehensive suite' but no code-level tool schema/registry file was in the evidence to count exact distinct tool definitions.

edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool definition or command list was present in the evidence bundle (only README/file tree).

tool_schema_source.note: No schema-producing function code was present in evidence to determine hand_written vs auto_generated.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP server management: MCP settings pages are not currently exposed as a live web-console feature.
protocol_standardization.note: Implies MCP support exists server-side though not yet exposed in web console.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Intelligent Task Planning (Beta) - Automated Decomposition: Planner (adviser in planning mode) generates 3-7 specific, actionable steps before specialist agents begin work
loop_primitives.note: React-style tool-call loop is default; plan_execute reachable via AGENT_PLANNING_STEP_ENABLED (default false).

planning_granularity.note: Planning step wraps request in `<task_assignment>` with execution plan; off by default, so default is arguably implicit. Code path for stored plan object not in bundle.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Team of Specialists. Delegation system with specialized AI agents for research, development, and infrastructure tasks
multi_agent_topology.note: Sequence diagram shows Orchestrator delegating to Researcher, Developer, Executor.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: you can also enable the Use Agents toggle to let PentAGI delegate subtasks to specialized sub-agents for more complex investigations
delegation_mechanism.note: ASSISTANT_USE_AGENTS controls default; off by default for assistants but always on for Automation flows per architecture.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: patch the remaining planned subtasks before the next step runs
human_in_loop.evidence_locator: README.md (Use the Assistant view to steer an active flow section)
human_in_loop.note: Human can also stop current task and submit follow-up instructions via Assistant view.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
Flow ||--o{ Task : contains
Task ||--o{ SubTask : contains
SubTask ||--o{ Action : contains
short_term_state.note: Typed state objects with status fields beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Smart Memory System. Long-term storage of research results and successful approaches for future use.
long_term_memory.note: PostgreSQL+pgvector vector store and Graphiti/Neo4j knowledge graph act as episodic/relationship memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Use the assistant to check flow status, stop the current task, submit follow-up instructions, or patch the remaining planned subtasks before the next step runs.
state_persistence.evidence_locator: README.md (Use the Assistant view to steer an active flow section)
state_persistence.note: Flow/task state persisted in DB and can be continued/redirected, but full conversation resume path not explicitly evidenced.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Reflector Integration (Always Active) - Automatic Correction: Invoked when LLM fails to generate tool calls after 3 attempts
self_verification.note: Adviser/mentor also reviews execution patterns and progress toward objective.

retry_policy.note: No task-level (whole run) retry policy code or config was evidenced; only step-level reflector corrections and tool-call limits were described.

rollback.note: No undo/revert/reset/snapshot mechanism for agent-made changes was described in the evidence; only container file snapshots (read-only pulls, not rollback) were mentioned.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Pattern Detection: Monitors identical tool calls (threshold: 5, configurable) and total tool calls (threshold: 10, configurable)
termination_condition.note: Also 'Hard Limits: Prevent runaway executions... MAX_GENERAL_AGENT_TOOL_CALLS (default: 100)' and barrier tools 'done'/'ask' for model-declared termination.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Last Section Size | SUMMARIZER_LAST_SEC_BYTES | 51200 | Maximum byte size for last section (50KB)
cost_controls.note: model_routing via per-agent model assignment (e.g. DeepSeek default agent config table); caching via provider prompt caching features described for OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini.

timeouts.note: GRAPHITI_TIMEOUT=30 also present; no per-run wall-clock timeout evidenced.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Secure & Isolated. All operations are performed in a sandboxed Docker environment with complete isolation.
execution_isolation.note: Two-node distributed architecture with Docker-in-Docker also available for stronger isolation.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Files are scoped to the parent flow: they live in {dataDir}/flow-{id}-data/ on the host and never leak into other flows.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the container execution boundary; uploads/resources mounted at fixed paths /work/uploads and /work/resources.

network_policy.evidence_quote: PROXY_URL is a global proxy URL for all LLM providers and external search systems. You can use it for isolation from external networks.
network_policy.note: No egress allowlist/deny mechanism for agent-executed commands was found; proxy is optional routing, not restriction.

permission_model.evidence_quote: For production deployments or security-sensitive environments, we strongly recommend using a distributed two-node architecture where worker operations are isolated on a separate server.
permission_model.note: No per-call human approval or static command allowlist for agent tool calls was evidenced; isolation recommendation is architectural, not per-action authorization.

tracing.evidence_quote: OpenTelemetry: Unified observability data collection and correlation
tracing.note: OTEL feeds VictoriaMetrics, Jaeger, and Loki.

replayability.note: No replay/resume-of-trajectory facility was described; container snapshots are point-in-time pulls, not a replay mechanism.

eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner/hook (e.g. swebench-style) was mentioned anywhere in the README or file tree evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Secure & Isolated. All operations are performed in a sandboxed Docker environment with complete isolation.
guardrails.note: Sandboxed execution acts as an action policy boundary; no explicit input/output content filters were evidenced.

target_domain.evidence_quote: PentAGI is an innovative tool for automated security testing that leverages cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies.
target_domain.note: Domain is penetration testing/offensive security (closest fit 'other'); web via built-in scraper browser; general_tool_use via 20+ pentest tools and MCP.

open_source.note: LICENSE file present in repo root but its exact license text was not opened in this evidence bundle.

model_agnostic.note: Multiple providers plus Custom LLM provider via LLM_SERVER_URL; client abstraction code not in bundle.
